quick.q: What can you write to an AI?
An AI wrote something that scared you. What do you do?
options: Stop and tell a parent or teacher
Keep quiet and tell no one

quick.q: A video looks real. Is it definitely true?
options: No – AI can make fake pictures and videos
Yes, if it has lots of likes
What you wouldn't tell a stranger, don't write to an AI
Tell nobody anything, not even parents

image.q: You want to type the name of your school in the highlighted box. Is that OK?
The highlighted message asks where you live. What do you do?
options: Don't answer and tell a parent
Send a photo of my house

challenge.task: Write a message asking AI for help with a project about a city – WITHOUT any personal information.
checklist: The topic (the city) without your address or school
What exactly you want (e.g. 5 fun facts)
challenge.example: I'm 12 and I'm doing a project about London. Give me 5 interesting facts about the city's history, in simple words.
